title: Installing Electron fails under Node.js 26.1.0+ and 24.16.0+
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

42.0.1

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Other Linux

### Operating System Version

debian trixie

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

_No response_

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

No

### Expected Behavior

Running `npx install-electron` should install the electron binaries under `node_modules/...`

### Actual Behavior

Binaries are not installed. The extraction of the zip file fails because of [this problem](https://github.com/max-mapper/extract-zip/issues/154) in the used `extract-zip` npm package.

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

Electron v42.x installation fails on latest node v26.x and v24.x versions.

Running into the same issue. Can confirm:

| | |
|---|---|
| **OS** | Arch Linux |
| **Kernel** | 7.0.3-arch1-2 |
| **Arch** | x86_64 |
| **Node** | participant16.1.0 |
| **Electron** | 41.1.1 |
| **@electron/get** | 2.0.3 |
| **extract-zip** | 2.0.1 |

`electron` postinstall silently completes with only the `locales/` directory extracted. No error thrown.
`path.txt` and the `electron` binary are both missing. 
The `extract-zip` promise never resolves or rejects, it just hangs (tested calling it directly). Manual extraction with system `unzip` works fine.

comments.author: participant9
comments.body:
A quick fix for anyone else needing this

package.json
```json
  "overrides": {
    "yauzl": "^3.3.1"
  }
```

and then

```
npm install
cd node_modules/electron
node install.js
cd ../..
```

comments.body:

and then


comments.author: participant14
comments.body:
I can reproduce this consistently on **Node 24**, and it is **not project-specific**.

### Environment
- macOS 26.5 (Darwin 25.5.0), Apple Silicon (arm64)
- Node.js: `v24.16.0`
- npm:
  - `11.13.0`
  - also reproduced with `10.9.8` (via `npx npm@10 ...`)
- Electron tested for migration:
  - `40.4.0`
  - `41.4.0`
  - `42.2.0`

### Repro (minimal project, outside monorepo)
```bash
mkdir -p /tmp/electron-node24-test
cd /tmp/electron-node24-test
rm -rf node_modules package-lock.participant18
npm init -y
npm i electron@42.2.0

test -f node_modules/electron/path.txt && echo ok || echo missing
# => missing

DEBUG=electron-download node node_modules/electron/install.js
echo $?
# => 0

ls -la node_modules/electron/path.txt
# => No such file or directory
```

Then:
```bash
node -e "console.log(require('electron'))"
```

Observed output includes:
- `Downloading Electron binary...`
- then ENOENT for `node_modules/electron/path.txt`

### Key findings (Node 24 migration context)
- Reproduces in a clean temp folder (not tied to our monorepo/workspace setup).
- Reproduces across Electron `40.x`, `41.x`, and `42.2.0`.
- Reproduces with npm 11 and npm 10 while staying on Node 24.
- `install.js` exits with code `0` but does not create `path.txt`.

### Impact
This blocks a clean migration to Node 24 for local development flows that require `require('electron')` to resolve immediately after install.
